caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular swatch of woven fabric placed horizontally against a plain, off-white background. The fabric is composed primarily of a muted green color, with a texture indicative of tightly interlaced threads. Along the left and right edges, as well as near the center, there are vertical stripes in alternating colors: black, dusty pink, pale blue, and a recurring muted green. The color pattern of the stripes is mirrored from left to right, with each color band being of roughly equal thickness and bordered closely together. The edges of the fabric have a frayed appearance, showing the ends of individual threads. The overall presentation is centered on the page, with the fabric swatch neatly displayed within a rectangular outline faintly visible around it. The background remains entirely blank except for some minor brownish spots and signs of age.
title: Linsey Woolsey
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
